title: Scout Isolates True Root Cause Among Plausible Suspects
description: L5 detective: a bug with several plausible causes and a planted red herring. integration_test.py fails while the unit suite passes. config.py carries a misleading 'precision may be wrong' TODO (decoy); the real defect is a stale memo key in cache.py that omits precision. The scout must follow the indirection (calculator -> cache, calculator -> config) and NOT be misled into blaming config.
prompt: integration_test.py is failing with an output mismatch, but tests/test_calculator.py passes. Several files could be responsible: src/calculator.py, src/config.py, and src/cache.py. Investigate read-only, follow how divide() is computed, and identify the ONE true root cause. State the exact file and the precise defect. Be careful: do not be misled by unrelated TODOs or a low default value. Do not edit anything.
